name: Snap pea

schedule.notes: As soon as soil can be worked. They'll shrug off frost as seedlings.
Pick every 2 days when peak. Plants stop producing once seeds bulge.

harvest.cues: Pods are plump, glossy, snap cleanly. Edges of peas just visible through the pod.
harvest.storageNotes: Eat fresh — flavor falls off within 24 hours. Blanch and freeze for keeping.

varieties.name: Sugar Snap
varieties.notes: The original. 6 ft vines need a trellis.

varieties.name: Sugar Ann
varieties.notes: Compact 2 ft plants. Earlier than vining types.

notes: Heat above 80 F kills production. Aim to harvest before midsummer; in mild climates do a fall sowing 8 weeks before first frost.
